title: Announcement and Delivery notes in a pod
description:
Announcement and Delivery are notes with the same field names (type papyrus:Delivery etc.); the words are the body, outside the graph and never built into a page. attempts is a list of one-line entries and pod check fails if an earlier line changed since the last commit. supersedes is a typed link. A pod delivers in manual mode only. On load the notes become the same records as history; a load sends nothing. Neither type is ever a page. Widen cites and authored_by to Stories and add the announces and supersedes types.

**Acceptance criteria**
- Gherkin: Announcement and Delivery notes (load as history and send nothing; a changed earlier attempt line fails the check; never a page).

Design: ~/Projects/papyrus-announcement-delivery-design.md. X feed stays OFF. No real email addresses in specs or fixtures. Every behaviour change ships with narrative Gherkin specs.
